 Job Description: 
 cquire technical skillsets and become a product expert in Smart Manufacturing solutions
 Provide technical presales support to the sales team
 Managing & interpreting customer requirements and conduct site study and come out with solution proposal for the customer.
 System specification development
 System design, development, testing, debugging and commissioning of software system.
 Overlook software project implementation.
 Lead and guide software engineer in software development.
 Work closely with various business units and third-party partners to deliver a total solution.
 Provide product & technical training to peers, sales team, business partners & customers.
 
 Job Requirement 
 Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
 3 to 5 years working experience in software development industry.
 Good knowledge in .Net, Java, Python and/or mobile application software development languages.
 Good knowledge in Linux and Windows operating system.
 Good knowledge in relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle DB, Postgresql, MySql, etc.)
 Knowledge in MES, CMMS, IoT and Smart Manufacturing Solutions an added advantage
 Knowledge in Business Intelligence (BI) Tools (e.g., QlikSense, Power BI, Tableau, etc.) an added advantage.
 Proficient in IT process and application consultancy
 Embrace current new technology and innovation.
 Able to work under minimum supervision.
 Solution driven person and have “can-do” mentality.
 Problem solving attitude.
 Creative and innovative
 Fresh graduate is also encouraged to apply.
